title: LDAP Service Attack Surface
detail: 1) Anonymous bind probe: ldapsearch -x -H ldap://T -b '' (use rootDSE to obtain namingContexts). 2) Dump the full tree anonymously to find accounts/passwords in descriptions. 3) With credentials, spray them against other services (SSH/web login reuse). 4) Injection: if a web form concatenates an LDAP filter, use filter injection such as * ) (uid=* (a common login bypass: uid=*)(|(&))). 5) Callback-style attacks (JNDI injection) are usually Java targets. Note: when starting a local LDAP service for debugging, use a nohup/foreground approach; background services may be reaped in containers.
